Audience measurement calculates how many people are in an audience, usually in relation to radio listenership and television viewership
The term is sometimes used with regard to practices that help broadcasters and advertisers determine who is listening

Radio surveys, still used for radio ratings in a number of countries, are normally available quarterly. ... diarists participating in a radio sample will accurately record their listening at 15-minute intervals
